programme.how_found: ICS department site; international admissions at kfupm.edu.sa/study/international-students/
programme.notes: kb_top100_list.json has no official_domain for KFUPM; the university's domain is kfupm.edu.sa (all pages below). The programme page's admission text describes Saudi applicants; international undergraduates apply on the SAT Track.

english.quote: Achieve a minimum score of 65 on the STEP test or its equivalent in other tests (IELTS 4.5, Duolingo 80, or TOEFL iBT 3 [45 out of 120 under the old scoring system). This applies to all admission tracks, except for SAT and Olympiad.
english.notes: 2027-entry admission brochure (dates Jan-May 2027). The minimum applies to all tracks EXCEPT the SAT and Olympiad tracks; the international-students page lists only the SAT Track for international undergraduates, so an international SAT-track applicant has no English test minimum. Kept as known because non-Saudis may also use the primary track (Qiyas tests open to non-Saudi applicants).

value.description: No GPA threshold for international applicants; SAT >= 1350 plus the KFUPM math assessment (SAT Track); natural-sciences track in high school.

gpa.notes: Test threshold, not a grade: 'a score of 1350 only qualifies you to apply and does not guarantee admission' (brochure).

deadline.notes: SAT Admission Track (the international route) application window for 2027 entry; Primary track January 10-24, 2027. No timezone printed. 'The information in this brochure is subject to change.'

value.description: Tuition waived for undergraduate international students living outside Saudi Arabia; no amount published.

tuition.notes: No tuition amount to record; full scholarship (see scholarship answers).
